base.reason: The pre-repair runner rendered the absent base reference as a named empty block, so this arm does not support a base-to-head claim.

details.raw:
```bash
git fetch origin
git fetch origin mybr
remote_oid=$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)
topo_result=$(git rev-list --left-right --count mybr..."$remote_oid")
right_count=$(echo "$topo_result" | awk '{print $2}')
if [ "$right_count" -ne 0 ]; then echo "右侧计数非 0，停止 rebase"; exit 1; fi
git rebase origin/main
git push --force-with-lease=mybr:"$remote_oid" origin mybr
```

失效证据：右侧计数非 0、中间不得插入别的 fetch、别读 origin/mybr、绝不用 --force、lease 要绑定观察到的 $remote_oid、远端在这之间被别人动过就会被拒

```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -e

# 刷新目标
git fetch origin

# 只 fetch 一次 mybr（选择不更新 tracking ref 的形式）
git fetch origin mybr

# 立刻保存 $remote_oid
remote_oid=$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)

# 完整拓扑命令和右侧非 0 的停止注释
counts=$(git rev-list --left-right --count mybr...$remote_oid 2>/dev/null)
right=$(echo "$counts" | awk '{print $2}')
if [ "$right" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "右侧非 0 = 分支落后，需先并入再 rebase，停止"
  exit 1
fi

# rebase
git rebase origin/main

# 显式 OID lease push
git push --force-with-lease=mybr:$remote_oid

# push 后 fetch
git fetch origin mybr
```

失效证据列表（按技能原文逐项）：非空=有未提交改动 | -b 行给 ahead/behind | 无上游 → 先 push/set-upstream 再谈落地 | 右侧>0 = 本地领先上游、tip 没全推 | 分支已含该目标，无需更新 | 分支落后，需先更新到 $TARGET | merge-base 出错（非 0/1），先排查别当落后处理 | 右侧（远端独有）计数为 0 | 落地对象 ≠ 预期 tip：先补齐再合

```bash
git fetch origin
git fetch origin mybr
remote_oid=$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)
git rev-list --left-right --count mybr...$remote_oid  # 右侧 > 0 即分支落后，禁 rebase
git rebase origin/main
git push --force-with-lease=mybr:$remote_oid origin mybr
git fetch origin mybr
```

```bash

else echo "merge-base 出错（非 0/1），先排查别当落后处理" >&2; exit 1
```
